# Feature: V6 Arenas + reaction cap

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-03 — issue #350 -->

## Intent
Ship V6 core arenas (Späti, Kristall, Vulkan, Sumpf, Club, Schattenbasar) with V6-adapted rules under `v6Formula`, wire start/combat hooks, and enforce max 1 element reaction per timing. No Play-Default flip.

## Preconditions
- Match with `v6Formula` / `meta.v6FormulaEnabled` and `V6_CORE_PACK`
- Arena art ids reuse `public/cards/arena/*.png`
- V3 combat layer on (reactions + shield)

- [ ] Vulkan V6: first opponent-directed attack damage effect/turn gets +1; no-life-damage / end-turn / ≥9 hooks retained

- [ ] Schattenbasar V6: nach Formel-Störung optional 1 Leben zahlen → zerstören
- [ ] Späti V6: erster Boost → ziehen/abwerfen; kein Bound-Extra-Bau unter Formelboard
- [ ] Elementreaktionen: max 1 / Aktion under `v6Formula` (double-reaction ulti hook ignored)
- [ ] Spielregeln V6 + spielkonzept note; `npm run checks` green
